name: Ostrich The
overview: Scripture portrays the ostrich as a creature of remarkable yet troubling characteristics, emphasizing its imprudence and lack of wisdom. The ostrich is described as having wings and feathers, yet it leaves its eggs exposed in the sand, forgetting the danger they face from foot traffic and wild beasts, illustrating a hardened and cruel attitude toward its young. It is also noted for rapid movement and companionship with desolation, symbolizing extreme loneliness and abandonment. Additionally, the ostrich is considered unclean and unfit for food, reflecting its status among birds to be avoided.
